summary: Phase H — public application flow, anniversary 2027 dates, reports enrichment, RSVPs report, member self-check-in, role-change gating, intake fields, welcome email. Backend pytest: 24/24 PASS (full lifecycle: apply → admin approve → mongo token retrieval → set-password → login → replay blocked; reject; reports/members enriched; reports/rsvps with parent_event filter; self-check-in idempotent; anniversary 29-31 Jul 2027 dates; MM 403 on role-change endpoints). Frontend: /apply renders & submits → 'Application received' confirmation; Login has Apply link; /admin Members shows 'PENDING APPLICATIONS' panel with Approve/Reject (7 awaiting review); Reports has new RSVPs sub-tab with member/event/RSVP'd/ticket/checked-in/guests columns; Members report code has events_attended + guests columns; Profile has intake-line and intake-completed-at inputs. ONE GAP FOUND: EditMemberDialog in Admin.jsx is missing intake_line + intake_completed_at INPUTS — only present as read-only DetailRows in MemberCardDialog. Review request explicitly states they should be editable in Admin → Edit Member dialog.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing INPUTS for intake_line and intake_completed_at. Dialog only contains em-email, em-first, em-line (line_name, NOT intake_line), em-address, em-state, em-zip, em-country, em-join-date, em-expires-preview, em-birthdate, em-status, em-chapter, em-role, em-new-password, em-save-btn. Backend PUT /api/members/{id} accepts intake_line/intake_completed_at but admin has no UI to edit them (only viewable on Member Card). Review request says: 'now also includes Intake Line + Intake Completion Date inputs (newly added). Saving persists them.' — NOT IMPLEMENTED on admin Edit dialog (Profile page DOES have them).

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' on EditMemberDialog and others (a11y warning, cosmetic).
Recharts warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' appears repeatedly (cosmetic; chart still renders once container has size).

action_items: Add intake_line + intake_completed_at INPUTS to EditMemberDialog in /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx (with data-testid='em-intake-line' and 'em-intake-completed-at'). Wire to PUT /api/members/{id} payload. Backend already supports it (verified via curl + pytest test_admin_can_set_join_date pattern and TestProfileIntakeFields).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 4419 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend modular split (already flagged in iteration 9).
Public application flow has no rate limit on POST /api/auth/apply — vulnerable to bot signups. Consider adding a CAPTCHA or rate limiter (e.g., slowapi).

_send_set_password_email failures are silent (best-effort). If RESEND_API_KEY rotates or domain unverified, admin won't see this in approve response. Consider returning {email_sent: bool} alongside {ok, user_id}.

PublicApplicationIn fields like address/city/state/zip are NOT marked required at the Pydantic level (all default to ''). Frontend marks them as required with red asterisks. Backend should mirror — either make them required or remove the asterisk on /apply.
DialogContent components missing aria-describedby across EditMemberDialog/GuestManager/Apply (already noted in iteration 9). Low-priority a11y.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% — all flows verified except admin EditMemberDialog intake inputs which are missing
